## About
Total Pro AC was started by former coworkers who teamed up to build an air conditioning company of their own. We work out of our office on North Pima Road in Scottsdale and serve homes and businesses across the Phoenix metro.
We install, repair, maintain and upgrade AC systems, including central air and ductless mini-splits. We try to listen first, explain what we find, and give you a straight recommendation.
Our customers have rated us 5 from 56 Google reviews. We are licensed, bonded and insured, and we would be glad to help you stay cool through an Arizona summer.

## Services
- AC installation: We help you choose the right system for your home and handle the installation from start to finish.
- Mini-splits: Ductless mini-splits for spaces like media rooms, garages and casitas.
- AC repair: We track down what is wrong with your system and fix it so your home is comfortable again.
- AC maintenance: Routine inspections, cleanings and tune-ups to keep your system running well and help prevent breakdowns.
- Energy-efficient upgrades: If your current system is getting old, we can walk you through more energy-efficient options.
- Emergency AC service: AC trouble does not wait for business hours, so we take emergency calls 24/7.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer emergency service?
A: Yes. We offer 24/7 emergency AC service, including nights and weekends.

Q: Are you licensed and insured?
A: Yes. Total Pro AC is licensed, bonded and insured, ROC #338783.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We serve the Phoenix metro and surrounding areas from our office in Scottsdale.

Q: Is financing available?
A: Yes, financing is available. Give us a call to talk through your options.
